answer: Each agent commits 64 GB of RAM and seals a Blake3 traversal plan. A horizon verifier issues random cache-line offsets the agent walks in sequence, each step hashing the prior line onward, so skipping breaks the chain. The vault ledger replays 5 percent of transcripts; any mismatch slashes the agent's 2,000 POA bond and freezes it for 30 days. Timber timestamps from three witnesses bound each proof to 400 milliseconds, proving real hardware ran it. One honest agent walks one array once; ten fakes must walk ten distinct arrays in parallel, paying ten times the RAM.
